title: Exploratoria
description: An exploration modpack for nomadic tinkers
body:
Exploratoria Early Alpha

Exploratoria is an exploration technology mod where you build and upgrade an airship to travel the world... and beyond. It focuses on exploring the vast Overworld and the dimensions beyond it, using your trusty airship.

This pack is in early alpha currently, so expect many changes, polishes, and additions.

Current Mod Highlights:

- Tinker's Construct
- Create
- Immersive Aircraft (Will likely change or be removed)
- The Ceilands
- The Aether
- More to come!
